csv.label: CSV
csv.note: Generic comma-separated file — for a spreadsheet, or any portal that accepts a custom upload.

xlsx.label: Excel (XLSX)
xlsx.note: The same columns as CSV in a formatted workbook — easiest to eyeball before uploading.

hdfc.label: HDFC NEFT
hdfc.note: First-version NEFT text template. Verify one file against the HDFC portal before a live upload.

icici.label: ICICI NEFT
icici.note: First-version NEFT text template. Verify one file against the ICICI portal before a live upload.

sbi.label: SBI NEFT
sbi.note: First-version NEFT text template. Verify one file against the SBI portal before a live upload.

noBankFileYet: No bank file for this run yet
bankFileInfo: The bank file lists each employee's account number, IFSC and net pay for this run — it is what you upload to the bank to actually move the money. It contains plaintext account details, so only HR admins can generate or download it.
chooseFormatHint: Pick what your bank's portal accepts. The figures are identical in every format — only the layout differs.
heldEmployeesNote: Held employees are never included — their pay is on hold by design.
adminOnlyNote: Generating and downloading bank files is limited to HR admins. You can see which files were produced below.
excludedCount_one: {{count}} employee excluded — fix their bank details and regenerate
excludedCount_other: {{count}} employees excluded — fix their bank details and regenerate
excludedHint: They are not in this file, so uploading it as-is pays everyone else and leaves them unpaid. Add the missing account details under ERP → People, then generate the file again.
noneExcluded: Everyone on this run is in the file — nobody was excluded for missing bank details.
filesGeneratedHint: Every bank file built for {{scope}} is kept, so you can prove later exactly what was uploaded. The excluded list is only shown for the file you just generated — regenerate to see it again.

errors.loadHistory: Could not load the bank files generated for this run.

noBankFileGeneratedDescription: Once you generate one it is listed here with its record count and total, and can be downloaded again.
